reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Thanks for asking. Estrogen can shift recovery, body composition and how quickly you adapt, and the research is still developing, so the specifics vary a lot between people. The best guide is your own data: track your strength, sleep and soreness over a few weeks and let that shape how hard you push. Your endocrinologist or prescriber is the right person for anything about your hormone levels or dosing. Once you tell me your goal and your week, I'll build the program around you."}
